name: Space radiation
one_line_effect: Space radiation raises long-term cancer risk, and a solar storm can raise the dose within hours.

name: Isolation and confinement
one_line_effect: Long confinement with the same few people strains mood, sleep and teamwork.

name: Distance from Earth
one_line_effect: Far from Earth, messages take minutes to arrive, so the crew must judge a health problem on their own first.

name: Altered gravity fields
one_line_effect: Changed gravity shifts fluids and loads muscle and bone, and it changes how much work each exercise rep takes.

name: Hostile, closed environment
one_line_effect: A sealed cabin depends on clean air, safe temperature, light and food. Poor CO2 control, heat or low fluid intake harms health and focus.
